document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You learn about the expedition members: Captain Crawford, Prof. 
Eustace Blake (expedition leader), Dr. Jerome Thompson (team 
physician), Olav Fram (in charge of equipment, including the 
three Dornier aircraft), Peter MacPherson (pilot), Eddy Smith 
(pilot), Wallace Bering (pilot), Dr. Jason Rambeau (geologist), 
and first mate Paddy Jones (who doubles as radio officer).
There are eighteen able seamen who assist the expedition in 
various ways. If you want gossip about any of the personnel, try 
the Captain at 476, or the Professor at 493. Decide whether you 
are using Charm, Fast Talk, Intimidate, or Persuade, then go to 
the entry. You can try one daily.
(455, 465, 476, 493, 500)
